origin.description: Alias of checkSetEqual. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is the same set of values, ignoring order and duplicates.
origin.usage: check_set_equal(x, y, ordered = FALSE, fmatch = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: ordered
arguments.text: When true, classes or factor levels must be in this order.

arguments.name: fmatch
arguments.text: Ignored. Matching uses Python's base match.

origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
